description: This file defines the Product model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically within the admin model catalog scope. It includes methods for creating, updating, copying, retrieving, and deleting products and related data such as descriptions, codes, categories, filters, attributes, options, and SEO URLs. It serves as the core data access layer for product management in the admin interface of the platform.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: The Product class extends the base Model class and provides comprehensive CRUD operations and related data management for products within the OpenCart admin catalog module, facilitating product creation, update, duplication, retrieval, and deletion, along with handling associated descriptions, codes, categories, filters, attributes, options, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product record in the database using the provided data array, handling main product info, description, codes, categories, filters, store associations, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, images, rewards, SEO URLs, and layout settings.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product record in the database identified by product ID, replacing main data and managing related descriptions, codes, categories, filters, store associations, downloads, related products, attributes, options, subscriptions, discounts, images, rewards, SEO URLs, and layout settings.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes the product record by ID and cleans up associated data including descriptions, codes, categories, filters, attributes, images, layouts, options, related products, rewards, SEO URLs, and linked reviews and coupons.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of a product, copying data and associations, resetting identifiers like SKU and upc, and returning the new product ID.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Adds a new product variant linked to a master product ID, overriding default values with optional override data.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Modifies a product variant identified by product ID, based on its master product, applying override options where specified.

methods.name: editVariants
methods.description: Bulk edits all variants associated with a master product ID, updating their data based on override flags and supplied data.

methods.name: editMasterId
methods.description: Updates the master ID reference for a given product, useful for setting or changing product hierarchies.

methods.name: editSale
methods.description: Updates the sale count for a product, reflecting sales activity.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Sets the review rating for a product.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Changes the active/inactive status of a product.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a product, including variant and override data decoded from JSON.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products filtered and sorted by specified criteria, returning detailed product info including variants.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of total products matching optional filters for pagination and reporting.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByManufacturerId
methods.description: Counts products associated with a specific manufacturer ID.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByTaxClassId
methods.description: Counts products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByStockStatusId
methods.description: Counts products with a specific stock status.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByWeightClassId
methods.description: Counts products with a specific weight class.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByLengthClassId
methods.description: Counts products with a specific length class.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a description record for a product in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description records for a given product.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a product across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all product descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: addCode
methods.description: Adds a code record to a product, linked via identifier_id.

methods.name: deleteCodes
methods.description: Deletes all code records associated with a product.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Fetches all codes related to a product along with their associated identifiers.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a product with a category.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes all category associations from a product.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Removes all product associations for a specific category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves category IDs assigned to a product.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a product with a filter.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes all filter associations for a product.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Removes all product associations for a specific filter.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves filter IDs associated with a product.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to a product for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteAttributes
methods.description: Removes attribute(s) from a product; optionally by attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteAttributesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all product attribute records for a specific language.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute records for a product, grouped by attribute ID.

methods.name: getAttributesByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all attributes for a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeId
methods.description: Counts how many products have a specific attribute.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Creates a new product option record for the product.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of a product, copying data and associations, resetting identifiers like SKU and UPC, and returning the new product ID.
